name: FirstEnergy

summary.text: FirstEnergy Corp. is an Akron, Ohio electric utility holding company. On July 22, 2021 it was charged with conspiracy to commit honest services wire fraud and signed a deferred prosecution agreement with the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Ohio, agreeing to pay a $230 million penalty and admitting that it paid millions of dollars to a 501(c)(4) controlled by then-House Speaker Larry Householder in return for nuclear-bailout legislation (House Bill 6), and that it paid $4.3 million to Ohio's utility regulator chairman. Householder was convicted of racketeering in 2023 and sentenced to 20 years.

openQuestions: Site claim (convicted; ~$60 million to Householder for HB6; 20 years; appeals lost; $230 million DPA; 2026 state mistrial of two ex-executives and re-indictment): federal elements supported. The 2026 Ohio state trial and mistrial were not confirmed from the sources used (site cites Cleveland 19).
Whether the federal charge against FirstEnergy was ultimately dismissed at the end of the DPA term was not confirmed.
